name: RF EDA AI Schematic Assistant
description: Create and revise schematics with an AI design service
description_full: Compact RF EDA assistant with backend-only feedback, indicator tables and manual schematic updates. AI jobs never draw automatically. Updating clears and redraws the target page inside a transaction, using ClearSchematicPage or complete GetItems/DeleteItems. Requires matching schematic IPC commands; Python packaging cannot add missing host handlers.
